title: Test and pure folders match on the path from the repository root
goal: A parent folder's name never hides or reclassifies files in check:conventions
acceptance: Failing-first fixture tests: a checkout under a parent folder named testing is still checked without sourceDirs; a pure folder matches only on the path from the repository root
CHANGELOG entry at the level the versioning rule gives (a project that newly fails may make it major; ask first)
privacy: Tool text only; fixtures are invented projects; no personal data.
escalation: A change to what a project without the setting checks that makes it newly fail is a major release; ask first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 at agent speed: two path tests in one copied check, fixtures and a release. Not a measurement.
